description: This file contains Kotlin extension functions for configuring the Spotless plugin in an Android project using Gradle. It defines specific formatting and license header configurations for XML, Kotlin, and Kotlin script files, tailored for different project modules such as Android, JVM, and root project.

methods.name: configureSpotlessForAndroid
methods.description: Configures Spotless formatting for Android-specific XML files, including setting targets, license headers, and newline requirements.

methods.name: configureSpotlessForJvm
methods.description: Configures Spotless for JVM-related files with common settings.

methods.name: configureSpotlessForRootProject
methods.description: Sets up Spotless for the root project, including Kotlin and Kotlin script files with license headers and editorConfig overrides.

methods.name: configureSpotlessCommon
methods.description: Defines common Spotless configuration applied across multiple modules, including Kotlin and Kotlin script formatting.
